criteria: When the Inactivity & Exit Intent Lightbox displays, exactly one utag.link call fires with event_name='lightbox_impression' and lightbox_name='inactivity-exit'
When a user clicks the primary CTA (accept), utag.link fires with event_name='lightbox_click' and lightbox_name='inactivity-exit', and navigation still proceeds (native anchor)
No analytics event fires on any close/dismiss/decline path (X, ESC, overlay, decline button, secondary close CTA)

When the reference field is configured, accept writes 'lightbox_accepted' and any decline close path writes 'lightbox_declined' into the designated EN field (same-page write and session-scoped redirect carry-over), flowing into Engaging Networks with the supporter's submission; accept owns the outcome — a close-action primary CTA leaves the field at 'lightbox_accepted' (D8)
With no field configured the reference-field writer is fully inert; Membership designates the deployed field value later
?debug=true or ?debug=log logs lifecycle events, exact utag payloads, field writes, and carry-over replays to the console; all other param states produce zero console output
window.utag absent, wrong-shaped, or throwing results in a guarded silent no-op; the asset never throws on the host page (repo invariant)
Event naming and parameter values match the stakeholder specification exactly and are validated in browser tooling and Playwright e2e

journeys.name: Lightbox display fires exactly one utag.link call with payload {event_name:'lightbox_impression', lightbox_name:'inactivity-exit'} — asserted against a window.utag recording stub on the public e2e harness loading the built dist/en-lightbox.js

Primary CTA accept fires {event_name:'lightbox_click', lightbox_name:'inactivity-exit'} AND navigation proceeds (native anchor) AND the configured EN field equals 'lightbox_accepted' — same-page write on the harness #en-form (including for a close-action accept CTA, per D8 precedence) and session-scoped carry-over replay on e2e/carry-over.html

Every decline close path (X, ESC, overlay click, decline/dismissLabel button, secondary close CTA) fires ZERO utag.link calls and writes 'lightbox_declined' into the configured EN field on the harness #en-form

?debug=true and ?debug=log log lifecycle events, exact utag payloads, EN field writes, and carry-over replays to the console (including with utag absent); no param, ?debug=false, ?debug=1, or malformed query produce zero output
Host page with no window.utag runs open/accept/close flows with zero page errors and no thrown exceptions (never-throw invariant)
